title: thelypteris dryas
intro: Thelypteris dryas, commonly known as Maiden's Hair Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, and its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris dryas include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and uses of this plant, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
